title: docs(skills): objectstack-automation carries the flow-authoring judgment of cloud's private corpus — option values, a named hour's zone, who an approval cascade runs as (#31155, port 2/3)
body:
Part of #31155 — card 1 of 4 of the objectstack-ai/cloud#3659 ruling-A split; this is the second per-domain port (`objectstack-automation`), after #31223 (`objectstack-data`). The `objectstack-ui` port follows as its own PR on the same card, so the card stays open.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

**Rework round 1** (contract review 6718050728, FAIL on 2ab1ee03): `origin/main` 77a675db merged by merge commit b73f1404 (no rebase, no force-push); `main` c0068ed6 (#31322) had added 24 bytes to `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` under the first pin, so CI measured the merge result at 5844 against a 5838 row. The row is re-pinned AT the merged measurement after a same-file pay-down (the three legacy "(the old …)" glosses), its comment and the tables below carry `main`'s true base 22908; SKILL.md item 4 now states the two legs' different consequences; the two pre-existing one-word errors the reviewer listed in that file are corrected in the same pass.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把云端私有搭建语料里「自动化」这一块、schema 表达不了的三条判断搬进公开的 `objectstack-automation` skill:① 流程条件和写入里的下拉值一律用选项的 `value`,不用用户嘴里说的标签(写在触发条件里:流程能过校验但永远不触发;写在 `fields` / `filter` 里:运行时以 `invalid_option` 拒绝);② 用户说「早上 9 点」就写 `'0 9 * * *'` 加 `timezone: 'Asia/Shanghai'`,不要自己换算成 UTC 裸写(裸写按 UTC 跑、也没记录你指的是哪个时区);③ 对审批结果做出反应的流程以「做出决定的那个人」的身份运行,保持 `runAs: 'user'`;只有 SLA 自动裁决和死亡运行释放这两种机器转换没有用户,要对它们也起反应的流程才声明 `runAs: 'system'`。外加 3 条 eval 用例。顺手把该 skill 一个参考文件里残留的 3 处中文注释改成英文(对外 skill 全英文),并改正该文件里两处原有小错(审批状态镜像值漏了 `returned`;一处示例条件缺 `record.` 前缀)。净增 71 行。返工第 1 轮:合并了 `main`(#31322 给同一文件加了 24 字节),体积上限按合并后实测重新钉住。
- 为什么改:执行 cloud#3659 裁决 A(一个知识源:本地开发与云端 AI 用同一套公开 skills)。第 ③ 条云端原文写的是「审批服务以系统身份回写,所以下游流程必须声明 system」,对照 `main` 上的审批服务是错的(回写带着决定人的身份),本 PR 按运行时的真实行为搬入,并在卡上记了更正。
- 风险与回滚:只改文档与 eval 夹具,无运行时改动;三个文件的体积上限按实测钉住(依据 cloud#3659 A 与「先削重复,余额按实测提高」,同文件先删了重复)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`(Approval Best Practices 第 4 条——身份判断,对照 `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` 的 `mirrorStatusField`)、`skills/objectstack-automation/references/examples-flows.md`(示例里新增的 `timezone`)、`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`(Valid-but-silently-wrong 第 4 条)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期全绿且 objectstack-automation 三行 headroom 0;`python3 -c "import json;json.load(open('skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json'))"` 不报错。
- 需要你做的:Tier H 受管面(`skills/**`),需要你的 APPROVED review 后由席位落地;本 PR 保持 draft。

## What changes

Four files under `skills/objectstack-automation/`, one changeset, three token-ratchet rows.

- `SKILL.md` § Valid-but-silently-wrong — item 4: a `select` is compared and written by its option `value`, never the label the request speaks, in the start `condition` AND every `fields` / `filter` entry. The two legs fail differently and the item says so: a label in the `condition` parses, matches no row, and the flow stages clean and never fires; a label in `fields` / `filter` fails the run at the write as `invalid_option` (`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`).
- `references/examples-flows.md` — the schedule example writes `schedule: { type: 'cron', expression: '0 9 * * *', timezone: 'Asia/Shanghai' }` with the rule beside it: a bare expression runs in UTC; a wall-clock hour the request names is written as said with its IANA `timezone`, never converted to UTC by hand (nothing then records which zone was meant). The time-relative cadence comment shows the same shape. Same-file pay-down: the `requires: ['automation', 'triggers']` / always-on `job` sentence, restated from SKILL.md § Prerequisite, is a pointer.
- `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` § Approval Best Practices — item 4: a flow reacting to the mirrored `approvalStatusField` runs as the person who acted (submit carries the submitter; approve / reject / recall / send-back the decider) and stays `runAs: 'user'`; only the SLA `escalation` auto-decision and the dead-run release carry no user, so a flow that must react to those too declares `runAs: 'system'`. Same-file pay-downs: the discount-approval example's four-line trigger comment (a restatement of SKILL.md § Trigger Configuration) is one pointer line; the three Chinese glosses (lines 145, 293, 366 on `main`) are gone; the three legacy "(the old `entryCriteria` / `back_to_previous` / `reject_process`)" glosses in § Branching, side-effects & rejection — approval-process keys with no author since ADR-0019 — are gone. Two one-word corrections of pre-existing text in the same file (the reviewer's optional items): the `approvalStatusField` row lists `returned` among the mirrored statuses (send-back writes it, approval-service.ts send-back path), and the dynamic-approval example's start condition reads `record.status == 'submitted'` like the rest of the file.
- `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` — cases 17 (option value, never label; CEL envelopes, no single-brace token), 18 (a named hour with its zone, never a hand-converted UTC cron), 19 (an approval-outcome cascade stays `runAs: 'user'`).
- `.changeset/31155-port-authoring-rules-automation.md` — `@objectstack/skills` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — three rows re-pinned AT the measurement (table below).

**Language scope (the approver's review on #31223, verbatim 「skills 对外发布的版本应该全部用英文」; the account owner's 「同意」):** every non-eval `skills/**` file this PR touches holds 0 CJK code points at the head (Python scan over the CJK, kana, fullwidth and CJK-punctuation blocks); eval prompt strings keep their Chinese under exemption (a); `objectstack-i18n` is untouched (exemption (b)). The touched reference file was one of the six pre-existing CJK carriers the delta reviewer listed on #31223; it is English now. The other five (`objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, `objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md`, `objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md`, `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`, `objectui/guides/i18n.md`) are not this PR's.

Authority: the ruling of record that orders this text into the published skills, objectstack-ai/cloud#3659 letter A (ruling comment 6682024726, 2026-11-06: "How to write valid, working metadata lives in the public skills … The private corpus's rules of that kind move there"), via the standing 2026-10-27 ruling, verbatim and untranslated: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068).

## No-loss mapping — the automation rows (v1 ledger 6711215678; corrections 6711710289, 6715112987; this PR's note on the card)

Classes as in the ledger: CLOUD (orchestration / hosted-only, stays), SPEC (restates `packages/spec`), E/R (parses clean, dead at runtime — the spec lane, #31224), STATED (the published skill already says it), PORT (judgment, ported here).

|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|

Verified on `main`: `system/job.zod.ts` `CronScheduleSchema.timezone` (described, IANA-checked); `trigger-schedule/src/schedule-trigger.ts` `normalizeSchedule` carries `timezone` onto the job (both the schedule and the time-relative trigger call it); `service-job/src/cron-job-adapter.ts` hands it to the cron library | eval 18 (`timezone: 'Asia/Shanghai'`, `0 9 * * *` must_contain; `0 1 * * *`, `UTC+8` must_not_contain) |

| 14c | "the approval service writes the outcome back with a SYSTEM write, which carries no user: a record-change flow reacting to it must declare `runAs: 'system'`" | **PORT, corrected** — the cloud sentence conflicts with the runtime on `main`: `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` `mirrorStatusField` is elevated but attributed (submit passes `submitter_id`; approve / reject / recall / send-back / revision-limit auto-reject pass `actingUserId(context)`); only the SLA auto-decision and the dead-run release pass `null`. Lint `flow-runas-unscoped` leaves `record_change` undecidable by design ("caught at run time") | `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` § Approval Best Practices item 4, stating what the runtime does | eval 19 (`runAs: 'user'`, the cascade's trigger shape must_contain; an approval node or a `sys_approval_request` read must_not_contain) |

The E/R half (`os validate` / `os build` refusing a node `type` outside the composed registry) is in the ledger's row but NOT among #31224's four candidates — named on the card for the spec lane | cloud `authoring-rules.test.ts` corpus integrity — stays in cloud |

Coverage decision the v1 ledger left to this PR: cloud `flow-value-envelope.test.ts` stays in cloud pointing at the moved text; eval 17 is the automation-side equivalent of its "every envelope the skill teaches passes clean" case (an envelope per field, no single-brace token), beside the spec refusal at save.

**Conflicts with spec on `main`:** none in the three ported clauses. One conflict with the runtime, resolved by porting the true statement (14c above); the cloud corpus's own sentence is for cloud to correct (card 4 of the split rewires that corpus).

## Tests

The eval file parses (`json.load`), ids 1–19 contiguous; a per-case cross-check over cases 17–19 finds no `must_not_contain` string inside its own `expected_output`. Prerequisite build for the skill gates under the shared verify lock: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build` — `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 71s`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Cloud corpus text that is false against this repo's runtime (carrier: cloud, card 4 cloud#3714 or a cloud card):** rule 14c's last sentence (quoted in the table). The hosted agent today over-elevates every approval cascade; the published skill now says what the service does.
- **Enforce-or-remove rows not in #31224 (for the seat, not filed here):** (i) `flow-node-types`' E/R half — a node `type` outside the composed registry parses (open string by contract, ADR-0018) and fails every run `NO_EXECUTOR`; the runtime audits it at boot (`sealNodeTypeVocabulary`), `os validate` does not; (ii) the mechanical half of rule 14's value-vs-label — a literal compared to a `select` field in a start `condition`, or written to one in `fields` / `filter`, that is none of the field's option `value`s; cloud's graph-lint has `flow_condition_uses_label` / `flow_field_value_uses_label`, this repo's lint has no equivalent. The judgment half (the request speaks the label) is the prose ported here.
- **Pre-existing CJK on `main` in five other shipped non-i18n files** (listed above): not this PR's; a separate card if the English-only rule is to cover the catalog.
- Eval `must_contain` tokens `== 'lost'` and `approval_status == 'approved'` are prompt-specific values, as `applicant_email` / `signed_copy` / `hotcrm.custom` are in cases 6, 8 and 13; the root catalog has no taught-token oracle (that gate scans `ui/skills` only).
